based_on: Mixes components from multiple Linux distributions
package_manager: Depends on installed strata; Bedrock package management tools

name: Bottlerocket
creator: Amazon Web Services
package_manager: Image-based updates; no general-purpose host package manager

name: DietPi
creator: DietPi community
description: A lightweight Debian-based distribution with optimized images and setup tools for single-board computers, PCs and servers.

name: Flatcar Container Linux
creator: Flatcar project
based_on: CoreOS Container Linux lineage; Gentoo-derived build system
package_manager: Image-based updates; no traditional host package manager
description: A minimal, immutable and container-optimized Linux operating system for cloud, virtualized and bare-metal environments.

name: Mobian
creator: Mobian community
description: A Debian-based mobile Linux project bringing Debian and touch-friendly interfaces to supported smartphones and tablets.

name: Nobara Linux
creator: Nobara Project
description: A Fedora-based desktop distribution with gaming, streaming, multimedia and content-creation software configured out of the box.

name: Qubes OS
creator: Qubes OS Project
based_on: Fedora-based dom0; Fedora and Debian virtual-machine templates
package_manager: DNF in dom0; package manager depends on each qube/template

name: Ubuntu Touch
creator: UBports community and UBports Foundation
package_manager: APT/dpkg (system image is managed by UBports)
description: A community-maintained Linux mobile operating system for supported phones and tablets, continued by UBports after Canonical ended development.

name: Vanilla OS
creator: Vanilla OS project
package_manager: APX for containerized package environments; ABRoot for system management
description: A desktop Linux distribution emphasizing an immutable, transactional base and containerized package management.

name: Whonix
creator: Whonix Project
description: A privacy-focused operating system designed to route network connections through Tor, commonly used as virtual machines.

name: Exodia OS
creator: Cyb3rTh1eveZ Team
description: An Arch-based distribution with customizable desktop editions, including general-purpose and cybersecurity-focused variants. Its project has described the editions as being under testing; check the official release page for current availability.

name: AcreetionOS
creator: AcreetionOS community
description: An Arch-based desktop distribution aiming to make Arch more approachable, with curated packages and multiple desktop editions.

name: aerynOS
creator: AerynOS project
description: An independently developed Linux distribution built around its own tooling and atomic update model. The project currently describes it as an alpha technical preview, not a production-ready daily-driver release.

name: Adélie Linux
creator: Adélie Linux project
description: An independent Linux distribution for desktops and servers, using musl libc, a GNU userland, APK packages and OpenRC or s6.

name: Exherbo
creator: Exherbo project
description: A source-based Linux distribution aimed at developers and experienced users who want flexible configuration and hands-on system maintenance.

name: NuTyX
creator: NuTyX project
description: A Linux From Scratch-inspired distribution for motivated users, featuring its own CARDS package manager and support for building packages from ports.

name: OpenWrt
creator: OpenWrt project
package_manager: opkg (stable releases); apk in newer development/release branches—check device and release documentation
description: A Linux operating system for embedded devices and network equipment, providing a writable filesystem and package management for supported routers and devices.

name: Dragora GNU/Linux-Libre
creator: Dragora project
description: An independent GNU/Linux-Libre distribution focused on simplicity, user control and software freedom.

name: Horus OS
creator: Younes Tito (V7x / Vairous7x)
status: Developer-reported v1.1 release; direct download and underlying Linux base not independently verified
description: Arabic-first desktop operating system described by its developer as featuring switchable Desktop Worlds, a guided installer, a signed app store, built-in security tools and an update channel. Its underlying Linux base and package manager have not been publicly verified.
